arStrings.szText:
Used to open a {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair, 1.8} {c_important}Superior Lair Boss Hoard{/c}.

Acquired from {icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionBelial,1.8}{c_important}Belial, Lord of Lies{/c}, who sometimes ambushes after opening a {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair, 1.8}{c_important}Lair Boss's Hoard{/c}. 

Belial will only drop his treasure for those who opened the Hoard that caught his attention.

Only found in Torment difficulties.
Masterwork engravings and silver filigree spiral outward from a cluster of etched runes, with intricacies possibly outside the skill of human hands.
